behavior: An enable request under the operator veto receives a static 403 before Cloud client construction, credential lookup or network access.
The existing local-intent fence rechecks the veto after reading Cloud policy and before submitting enable; changed intent returns 409.
The service transaction rejects enabled approval while the operator veto is active, before persistence or audit, so removing the veto cannot reveal latent approval.
Explicit disable still persists local opt-out immediately and seeks remote acknowledgement; an outage retains the existing truthful pending notice.
